## Problem Statement
What reconnaissance or defensive workflow problem does this solve?

## Proposed Solution / Tool Integration
If proposing an external tool adapter, describe:
- Tool binary name and installation package (`apt` / `pipx` / `go`)
- Supported target types (`domain`, `ip`, `cidr`)
- Traffic mode (`passive`, `light-active`, `active`)
- Expected structured findings
